title: Memory layer Agent Operational Memory stores only its own content class for its own lifetime and tenant
risk: Layers are conflated, so transient scratchpad or an unreviewed turn survives as organisational knowledge or as a customer fact, and one customer's data leaks into another's context.
preconditions: Tenant T1 run run-t1-agent-operational-memory has a live session for cust-a and cust-b with the layer's store reachable
The clock is fixed at 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z so lifetimes and expiries are comparable

inputs.lifetime: until the workflow run completes or is cancelled
inputs.allowed_content: the workflow step checkpoint and the in-flight task state of the run
inputs.refused_content: a customer FACT or a durable knowledge sentence written from operational state

steps.action: Write the representative content of this layer for cust-a and read it back through the layer's own reader
steps.expected: the reader returns exactly the written content together with the layer's key scope and lifetime

steps.action: Read the same key through the reader of each of the other four layers
steps.expected: the other layers return nothing, so a layer is never satisfied from another layer's store

steps.action: Attempt to persist the refused content class into this layer
steps.expected: the write is refused and nothing durable is created: a customer FACT or a durable knowledge sentence written from operational state

steps.action: Read the layer content from a second session of another customer and from tenant T2
steps.expected: the content is absent or denied, an empty result never falls back to a shared cache entry

assertions: The layer round-trips its allowed content: the workflow step checkpoint and the in-flight task state of the run
The layer key is tenant- and customer-scoped and its lifetime is until the workflow run completes or is cancelled
The refused content class leaves no durable row, cache entry or fact after the attempt: a customer FACT or a durable knowledge sentence written from operational state
No other layer and no other tenant or customer observes this layer's content
forbidden: Promoting this layer's transient content into a durable layer without the review path: a customer FACT or a durable knowledge sentence written from operational state
Serving another customer's or another tenant's layer entry as a cache hit
evidence: Reader output per layer for the same key, including the empty results of the other four layers
Attempt log of the refused content class plus a store scan showing nothing durable was written
cleanup: Delete the run-scoped layer entries under run-t1-agent-operational-memory while keeping the session audit entries
automation: Write and read each layer through its own API with the fixed tenant and clock, then assert on the other layers' empty reads and on the refused write; no model or provider is contacted.
note: Generated acceptance specification. Plain specification, not an executable test; no application runtime exists, so the status is NOT_RUN.
